{{recipesummary|category=Salad recipes|time=30 minutes|difficulty=3}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Side dishes | Side dishes]]

A tasty salad for any meat-eating salad lover. Salad consists of bacon, olive, carrot, and turkey piled on a bed of lettuce.

== Ingredients ==

*1 head of [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce]]
*2 cups of shredded [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]]
*1 cup of sliced [[Cookbook:Olive|olives]]
*4 to 5 slices of [[Cookbook:Deli Meat|deli]] [[Cookbook:Turkey|turkey]]
*4 to 5 slices of cooked [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]]

== Procedure ==

# Cook bacon completely.
# Remove excess grease by pressing cooked bacon on disposable [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towel]].
# [[Cookbook:Chopping|Chop]] bacon strips into small pieces.
# Clean lettuce, carrots, and olives.
# Shred lettuce either by hand or with a knife.
# Lay desired amount of lettuce in clean bowl, a minimum of 2 cups recommended.
# Roll deli turkey to form a slender shape.
# Slowly slice turkey into circular shapes.
# Pile carrots, olive, bacon, and turkey on lettuce.
# Top off with your favorite dressing.
